headline: 7 bfBTC contract addresses catalogued across 7 chains from official docs; AILayer-specific address not listed in docs and AILayer explorer name-tag search inconclusive; SlowMist audit confirmed but PDF not parsed.
short_headline: 7 contracts across 7 chains; AILayer addr missing

findings.text: AILayer explorer (mainnet-explorer.ailayer.xyz) confirmed via search; no bfBTC name-tag result surfaced from search query 'bfBTC AILayer explorer'. The Blockscout-based explorer does not appear in standard block-explorer lists (etherscan.io etc.) and AILayer chainId is not supported by the DeFiPunkd read API. Three unrelated addresses surfaced from a search query but none carry a BitFi label.

Official deployed contracts page fetched at https://docs.bitfi.one/developer/bfbtc-overview/deployed-contracts. Lists bfBTC on BSC (0x623F2774d9f27B59bc6b954544487532CE79d9DF), Bitlayer (0xcdfb58c8c859cb3f62ebe9cf2767f9e036c7fb15), Hemi (0x623F2774d9f27B59bc6b954544487532CE79d9DF), ETH (0xCdFb58c8C859Cb3F62ebe9Cf2767F9e036C7fb15), BASE (0x623F2774d9f27B59bc6b954544487532CE79d9DF), CORE (0xCdFb58c8C859Cb3F62ebe9Cf2767F9e036C7fb15), GOAT (0x623F2774d9f27B59bc6b954544487532CE79d9DF), TAC (0x623F2774d9f27B59bc6b954544487532CE79d9DF). AILayer is notably absent from the official deployments list despite DeFiLlama showing ~$91M TVL on AILayer.

Audit page fetched at https://docs.bitfi.one/developer/audit-report. Two SlowMist audits confirmed: bfBTC audit (PDF at https://docs.bitfi.one/assets/bitfi-slowmist-audit.pdf, GitHub mirror confirmed) and bfUSD audit. GitHub page for the bfBTC SlowMist report was fetched but PDF binary was not rendered — contract addresses in scope could not be extracted this run.

GitHub org https://github.com/bitfi-labs surfaced from the docs site. No individual repo was fetched this run due to tool call budget exhaustion; no deployment artifact files (run-latest.json, deployments.json) were walked.

Protocol.chains = [AILayer] only. D1 attempted AILayer explorer search; returned three address URLs without BitFi labels. The deployed contracts docs page does not include an AILayer address. AILayer chain is not supported by DeFiPunkd read API (supported chainIds: 1,10,56,130,137,324,8453,42161,43114,59144,81457,534352,11155111). Zero addresses confirmed on AILayer from fetched sources.
No factory addresses surfaced from D1–D4 sources; D6 factory enumeration not applicable this run.

Role taxonomy applied to all addresses found. All bfBTC deployments categorized as token (OFT-standard ERC-20). No multisig, timelock, proxy admin, or governor addresses identified from docs. Docs note proxy designations only on testnet (Ethereum Sepolia, Bitlayer Testnet).

All addresses in admin_addresses[] trace to the fetched deployed contracts page (https://docs.bitfi.one/developer/bfbtc-overview/deployed-contracts). AILayer address absent from that page; cannot be included in admin_addresses[] without on-chain evidence.

rationale.verdict: Walked website, docs deployed-contracts page, audit report page, and SlowMist GitHub page. Catalogued 7 (logically 2 distinct) bfBTC token addresses across 7 chains (BSC, Bitlayer, Hemi, Ethereum, Base, Core, GOAT/TAC). The AILayer-specific bfBTC address — the only chain in protocol.chains — was not found in official docs and the AILayer explorer search was inconclusive. Grade is unknown pending AILayer address discovery.

protocol_metadata.about: BitFi is a CeDeFi (Centralized-Decentralized Finance) platform that lets users deposit Bitcoin and earn yields through a hybrid of institutional CeFi strategies (delta-neutral trading via Ceffu MirrorX) and on-chain DeFi integrations. Users stake BTC or other wrapped BTC assets to receive bfBTC, a LayerZero OFT-standard ERC-20 token backed 1:1 by BTC, which accrues yield over time and can be redeemed by burning. On AILayer specifically, the bfBTC token currently functions as a plain 1:1 wrapped Bitcoin without active yield strategies.
